111:t_3:65.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Through today's battle, $$クロノ$$'s forces will break away from the $$連邦軍$$ chain of command and gradually start moving on their own.」

111:t_3:67.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Our target is the $$セントラル・ベース$$ on this continent.」

111:t_3:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Some believe in the future, and some have abandoned it...)

111:t_3:69.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Are people... really moving toward the future...?)

111:t_3:75.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Proto $$プルトゥエルブ$$... That's your name, isn't it? Answer me.」

111:t_3:77.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You're supposed to obey your master's instructions.」

111:t_3:78.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You are not my master. If you want to make me obey, try readjusting me or torturing me.」

111:t_3:79.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Y-You there...! Watch your tone-」

111:t_3:80.en:
$$マーサ$$
「How naive of you, $$アルベルト$$. Entrusting her to you seems to have been a mistake.」

111:t_3:81.en:
$$マーサ$$
「No progress at all in these four months... However unsettled the world has been, I can only call it negligence.」

111:t_3:84.en:
$$マーサ$$
「At the very least, these four months have shown me that readjusting you is difficult. You are far too perfected.」

111:t_3:87.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I have no interest in people whose memories can be swapped so easily.」

111:t_3:88.en:
$$マーサ$$
「You will go on fighting with your past on your back. For my sake.」

111:t_3:90.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I can tell. That you were used as a tool by... men who know nothing but spilling blood...」

111:t_3:92.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Remember. What you were doing before $$ネオ・ジオン$$ picked you up...」

111:t_3:94.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Come now... lay your painful past bare. I will lead you out of it.」

111:t_3:95.en:
$$マーサ$$
「And then... I'll give you the power to fight...」

111:t_3:98.en:
$$マーサ$$
「The results of our investigation into her past. With this, readjusting her becomes possible.」

111:t_3:99.en:
$$マーサ$$
「She will lend us her strength... The strength to obtain the $$ユニコーン$$.」

111:t_3:100.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Even with the $$連邦政府$$ in this state, must we still protect $$ラプラスの箱$$?」

111:t_3:101.en:
$$マーサ$$
「I no longer expect anything from the $$連邦政府$$. I'll keep using them for as long as they're of use.」

111:t_3:102.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「Then what, exactly... do you intend to do once you have the $$ユニコーン$$?」

111:t_3:105.en:
$$マーサ$$
「So you did know. An organization that guarded something called a doctrine in the shadows of history, and gained immense power in exchange...」

111:t_3:106.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh heh... just like the $$ビスト家$$.」

111:t_3:108.en:
$$マーサ$$
「The one holding supreme power there contacted me. They said that if I hand over $$ラプラスの箱$$, we will be welcomed into $$クロノ$$.」

111:t_3:110.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Things being as they are, neither the $$ビスト家$$ nor $$アナハイム$$ is absolute.」

111:t_3:111.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Then, for the sake of our own survival, we will make use of the existence of that Box.」

111:t_3:113.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Don't trouble yourself with anything extra. You will use that $$マリーダ$$ and act on my orders.」

111:t_3:115.en:
$$マーサ$$
「Heh heh... the lion and the $$ユニコーン$$... Both are guardian deities of the $$ビスト家$$...」

111:t_3:116.en:
$$マーサ$$
「$$プルトゥエルブ$$... Protect us, won't you?」

111:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The battle between Mr. $$アムロ$$ and $$ギュネイ$$... It must have been painful, just watching.」

111:t_10:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I know a little what he's like. If we'd stepped in there, he would surely have looked down on us.」

111:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A fine thing, isn't it. Friendship that continues even when you're on opposing sides.」

111:t_10:8.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...It might not be quite the same as friendship...」

111:t_10:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「But if he's wavering, I want to reach out a hand to him.」

111:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That man is stubborn, after all. Once he's made up his mind, I doubt he'll change it easily.」

111:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, thanks to Mr. $$カミーユ$$'s words today and his defeat at the hands of Mr. $$アムロ$$, $$ギュネイ$$ has produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z.」

111:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally, I will be adding them to the unit's stock.」

111:t_10:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So his heart really is wavering, then...」

111:t_10:14.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... Next time I fight him, if $$Ｚチップ$$s are produced, let me know.」

111:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood. For both our sakes, yours and mine, I do hope $$Ｚチップ$$s keep pouring out!」

111:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I had honestly assumed that going to retake the $$νガンダム$$ came from the psychology of a child whose toy had been taken.」

111:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Or is it that, perhaps? That 'I'm the best at using a Gundam!' sort of thing...」

111:t_10:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You've got me there... I can't say a word when you bring up the old days.」

111:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come now...! Don't act so grown-up. Show us the fiery Mr. $$アムロ$$ of old once in a while!」

111:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Like when you got so angry at $$ギレン・ザビ$$'s speech that you smashed the monitor with your bare hands...」

111:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Where did the Mr. $$アムロ$$ go who used to get all chummy with Blondie?」

111:t_10:28.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What are you talking about...? Is that from some crackpot book about me in the $$一年戦争$$?」

111:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies! I was mistaken about all sorts of things!」

111:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please forget what I said earlier! There was no direct hit from a beam bazooka!」

111:t_10:32.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wait a second...! What are you talking about!?」

111:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm so sorry! It's almost time for the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ to open!」

111:t_10:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「If you change the subject that forcibly, it'll only make me more curious!」

ギレン・ザビ.evidence: Amuro's line (Gundam 0079): AG teases about Amuro smashing a monitor during Gihren Zabi's speech (Zabi family leader, Principality of Zeon); male.

kept_omissions: 111:t_3:79: Alberto's sentence is cut off by Martha (口の利き方に...); kept as 'Watch your tone-' with no explicit addressee (Marida, per scene)
111:t_3:90: 誰かの...男達 'someone's' collapsed into 'men who know nothing but spilling blood' (the 'tool of someone' owner is left unnamed in the source)
111:t_3:108: 最高権力者 (supreme power of Chrono) gender unknown; rendered with 'they' / no pronoun
111:t_10:27: パツキンさん (Blondie) referent and gender unspecified in the source; kept as 'Blondie'
uncertain: 111:t_3:73 caption: no token exists for オーガスタ　ニュータイプ研究所; used $$オーガスタ研究所$$ (Augusta Laboratory), dropping 'Newtype'.
111:t_3:75: プロト・プルトゥエルブ rendered 'Proto $$プルトゥエルブ$$' (Proto Ple Twelve); 'Proto' not tokenised.
111:t_3:77: マスター rendered lowercase 'master' (generic 'you obey your master', which Marida answers with 'You are not my master').
111:t_3:115: 獅子とユニコーン rendered 'the lion and the $$ユニコーン$$' (Vist family guardian emblem, also the Unicorn Gundam).
111:t_10:3 etc: AG's 様 rendered 'Mr.' to match the finished route-A and 2014_02 AG lines (not dropped), per the established AG voice.
111:t_10:26: new name proposed as $$ギレン・ザビ$$ (Gihren Zabi); not in the glossary sheet.

111:t_10:27: パツキンさんとシクヨロ is in-joke slang (blonde + reversed-slang 'pleased to meet you', i.e. getting cozy); rendered 'get all chummy with Blondie'. The next slice (2016_03, t_10:35) calls it 'パツキンさんのお守り', so the exact allusion is unclear.
111:t_10:31: ビーム・バズーカの直撃 rendered 'a direct hit from a beam bazooka' (allusion left opaque, as in the source).
111:t_3:65: '今日の戦いで' rendered 'Through today's battle' (the battle itself drives the split); alternative reading 'In today's battle'.
